drop.title: Drop a slide photo here

setup.label: Microscope setup
setup.hint: Calibrate once per microscope + phone: every capture is then analysed at the AI's magnification.

objective.label: Objective
objective.hint: µm/px is scaled from the setup's calibration — 40x sees 4× finer than 10x.
